id-20260831-news-3.title: House Budget Committee and Government Agree on 2027 State Budget Macro Assumptions, Economy Targeted to Grow up to 6.5 Percent

segments.src: Badan Anggaran (Banggar) DPR RI dan pemerintah akhirnya menuntaskan pembahasan asumsi dasar ekonomi makro dalam Rancangan Anggaran Pendapatan dan Belanja Negara (RAPBN) 2027.
segments.tr: The House of Representatives Budget Committee (Banggar) and the government have finally completed discussions on the macro-economic baseline assumptions in the 2027 State Budget Bill (RAPBN).

segments.src: Kesepakatan ini menjadi salah satu tonggak penting dalam rangkaian pembahasan anggaran negara tahun depan, sebelum masuk ke tahap pembahasan pos-pos belanja dan pendapatan yang lebih rinci.
segments.tr: This agreement marks an important milestone in next year's state budget discussion series, before moving on to more detailed discussions on expenditure and revenue posts.

segments.src: Dalam rapat kerja antara Banggar DPR dan pemerintah, kedua pihak menyepakati target pertumbuhan ekonomi nasional berada pada kisaran 5,8 persen hingga 6,5 persen.
segments.tr: During a working meeting between the House Budget Committee and the government, both parties agreed on a national economic growth target ranging from 5.8 percent to 6.5 percent.

segments.src: Angka ini mencerminkan optimisme terhadap prospek perekonomian domestik, sekaligus menjadi acuan bagi penyusunan target penerimaan negara dan alokasi belanja pada tahun anggaran 2027.
segments.tr: This figure reflects optimism regarding domestic economic prospects, while also serving as a reference for formulating state revenue targets and expenditure allocations for the 2027 fiscal year.

segments.src: ## Inflasi Dijaga di Rentang Terkendali
segments.tr: ## Inflation Maintained Within a Controlled Range

segments.src: Selain pertumbuhan ekonomi, laju inflasi turut menjadi perhatian utama dalam pembahasan asumsi makro tersebut.
segments.tr: In addition to economic growth, the inflation rate is also a primary concern in the discussion of these macro assumptions.

segments.src: Pemerintah dan Banggar DPR sepakat mematok target inflasi pada rentang 1,5 persen hingga 3,5 persen, dengan upaya menjaga agar laju kenaikan harga tetap berada di bawah batas atas 3,5 persen sepanjang tahun anggaran berjalan.
segments.tr: The government and the House Budget Committee agreed to set the inflation target at a range of 1.5 percent to 3.5 percent, with efforts to keep the price increase rate below the upper limit of 3.5 percent throughout the current fiscal year.

segments.src: Target inflasi yang terkendali ini dinilai penting untuk menjaga daya beli masyarakat sekaligus memberikan kepastian bagi dunia usaha dalam merencanakan aktivitas ekonomi.
segments.tr: This controlled inflation target is considered important to maintain people's purchasing power while providing certainty for the business world in planning economic activities.

segments.src: Stabilitas harga barang dan jasa juga menjadi salah satu indikator yang memengaruhi kepercayaan investor terhadap perekonomian nasional.
segments.tr: The price stability of goods and services is also one of the indicators affecting investor confidence in the national economy.

segments.src: ## Fondasi Pembahasan Anggaran Selanjutnya
segments.tr: ## Foundation for Subsequent Budget Discussions

segments.src: Kesepakatan atas asumsi dasar makro ini akan menjadi fondasi bagi pembahasan lanjutan RAPBN 2027, termasuk penyusunan target penerimaan pajak, belanja negara, hingga defisit anggaran.
segments.tr: This agreement on macro baseline assumptions will serve as the foundation for further discussions of the 2027 State Budget Bill, including the formulation of tax revenue targets, state expenditures, and the budget deficit.

segments.src: Sejumlah indikator lain seperti nilai tukar rupiah, suku bunga surat berharga negara, serta harga dan lifting minyak dan gas bumi juga turut dibahas sebagai bagian dari kerangka ekonomi makro yang lebih menyeluruh.
segments.tr: Several other indicators such as the rupiah exchange rate, state securities interest rates, as well as oil and gas prices and lifting were also discussed as part of a more comprehensive macroeconomic framework.

segments.src: Proses pembahasan ini berlangsung di tengah dinamika ekonomi global yang masih diwarnai berbagai tantangan, mulai dari ketidakpastian rantai pasok, fluktuasi harga komoditas, hingga perubahan arah kebijakan moneter di sejumlah negara besar.
segments.tr: This discussion process took place amidst global economic dynamics still colored by various challenges, ranging from supply chain uncertainties, commodity price fluctuations, to shifting monetary policy directions in several major countries.

segments.src: Pemerintah menekankan pentingnya asumsi makro yang realistis namun tetap mendorong optimisme, agar target pembangunan nasional dapat dicapai tanpa mengabaikan prinsip kehati-hatian fiskal.
segments.tr: The government emphasized the importance of realistic yet optimistic macro assumptions, so that national development targets can be achieved without neglecting fiscal prudence principles.

segments.src: ## Tahapan Selanjutnya
segments.tr: ## Next Stages

segments.src: Setelah asumsi dasar makro disepakati, pembahasan RAPBN 2027 akan berlanjut ke tahap pendalaman terhadap rencana kerja dan anggaran masing-masing kementerian dan lembaga.
segments.tr: After the macro baseline assumptions are agreed upon, the 2027 State Budget Bill discussions will proceed to the in-depth stage regarding the work plans and budgets of each ministry and institution.

segments.src: Banggar DPR bersama pemerintah dijadwalkan terus melakukan serangkaian rapat kerja untuk menyelaraskan program prioritas nasional dengan kapasitas fiskal yang tersedia.
segments.tr: The House Budget Committee together with the government are scheduled to continue a series of working meetings to align national priority programs with available fiscal capacity.

segments.src: Kesepakatan awal ini diharapkan dapat mempercepat proses pembahasan anggaran secara keseluruhan, sehingga RAPBN 2027 dapat disahkan tepat waktu sesuai dengan mekanisme dan jadwal yang telah ditetapkan dalam siklus penganggaran nasional.
segments.tr: This initial agreement is expected to accelerate the overall budget discussion process, so that the 2027 State Budget Bill can be ratified on time in accordance with the mechanism and schedule set in the national budgeting cycle.

segments.src: Publik dan pelaku usaha turut menantikan kepastian arah kebijakan fiskal tahun depan, mengingat asumsi makro ini akan berdampak langsung pada berbagai sektor perekonomian, mulai dari investasi, ketenagakerjaan, hingga daya beli masyarakat secara luas.
segments.tr: The public and business actors are also looking forward to certainty regarding next year's fiscal policy direction, considering that these macro assumptions will directly impact various economic sectors, ranging from investment, employment, to broad public purchasing power.
